## Engineering and sales hold two thirds of the budget

These illustrative figures give each team its budget. A part with children takes the sum of them; the chart never invents a value.

```chart
type: sunburst
title: Engineering is the largest group, then sales
subtitle: Thousands of dollars; angle is budget, colour is the top-level group
data:
  inline:
    - {part: Engineering}
    - {part: Platform, group: Engineering}
    - {part: Core, group: Platform, budget: 260}
    - {part: Tooling, group: Platform, budget: 160}
    - {part: Product, group: Engineering, budget: 310}
    - {part: Data, group: Engineering, budget: 150}
    - {part: Sales}
    - {part: EMEA, group: Sales, budget: 240}
    - {part: Americas, group: Sales, budget: 260}
    - {part: Operations, budget: 180}
    - {part: People, budget: 90}
    - {part: Finance, budget: 60}
encoding: {label: part, parent: group, y: budget}
axes:
  y: {unit: k}
```

*Source: Illustrative values.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each part's value and its share of the whole.
